data.title: 画廊话题营销形态
data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"image-text-2","attrs":{"id":"imageText_MdskV","src":"https://bbx-pic.gtimg.com/bbx/pictures/2026/458_20260803180234_217571.png","caption":"画廊话题营销形态","naturalWidth":2250,"naturalHeight":4872,"imgAlign":"right"},"content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"产品介绍"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"话题营销形态，将朋友圈海量曝光聚合于品牌话题落地页；落地页一站承接品牌精选视频、达人种草内容、用户评论表态与转化组件等多元内容，并连接朋友圈、视频号、搜一搜、公众号、小程序及腾讯营销互选平台等商业化资源协同引流，实现多场景联动；在用户与内容的持续互动中，促进浏览与停留、强化种草效果、放大话题声量。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"售卖方式"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"支持合约售卖。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"如有投放意向，可以联系你的行业 / 渠道运营经理，或拨打我们的销售热线获取帮助。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"销售热线："},{"type":"telphone","attrs":{"id":"telphone_T4eS9","telphone":4000617816},"marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}]}]}]}]}
